errors.evidence: The phrase "значително по-висок" (significantly higher) is a subjective interpretation of the difference between the values, which the prompt asks to avoid.
The phrase "сравнително стабилни" (relatively stable) is a subjective interpretation of the data trend, which the prompt asks to avoid. A more objective description would state the range of values.
The phrase "обратна тенденция" (opposite trend) is an interpretation of the data's behavior rather than a direct, objective description of the values shown.
The word "рязко" (sharply) is a subjective characterization of the rate of decrease, which qualifies as interpretation and is forbidden by the prompt.
The word "постепенно" (gradually) is a subjective characterization of the rate of increase, which qualifies as interpretation and is forbidden by the prompt.
